chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from one of our companions, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from Ṭāhir, who said:
I was in the presence of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, then Jaʿfar عليه السلام came forward, so Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “This is the best of created beings.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, the Imam in whose presence the event took place
key_terms.الْبَرِيَّةِ: the created beings; creation or mankind in this context
key_terms.جَعْفَرٌ: Jaʿfar عليه السلام, identified here as possessing supreme excellence
key_terms.خَيْرُ: the best; indicating superiority in virtue and rank
key_terms.عِنْدَ: in the presence of; indicating close attendance before the Imam

ai.seo_question: What did Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام say about Jaʿfar عليه السلام in al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام identifying Jaʿfar عليه السلام with exceptional virtue and rank. In Shia tradition, it serves as a biographical and theological indication of the distinguished status of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from one of our companions, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Tahir who said,

‘I was in the presence of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> kissed Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, and Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This one<sup>asws</sup> is the best of the Created beings’.
en.sarwar: 5.Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Khalid from some of our people from Yunus ibn Ya‘qub from Tahir who has said the following.
“Once I was in the presence of abu Ja‘far (a.s.) when Ja‘far (a.s.) came. Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) said, “This (Ja‘far ) is the best of the people.”
